proposed_values.claim: A cherry-picked commit that carries no PR of its own is named in the manifest as unattributed AND carries its own V-sign row.
proposed_values.rationale: The t26 candidate carries jbschooley's Zoom popup fix, lifted out of #1252's stack as its own car. It has an author, a founder V-sign and no PR - so nothing in the current contract makes its sign mandatory, and the manifest can only report that it is unattributed. This is a standing shape (a lifted commit is how a good fix escapes a stalled stack), not a t26 accident, which is why it belongs in the contract rather than in this train's fills.
